Definition: from the base of G1096; a parent:--parent.
BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, goneús is the word for parent. In Matthew 10:21, the text says "and the children shall rise up against [their] parents." In Mark 13:12, the text says "and children shall rise up against [their] parents."
TheologicalSignificance: What goneús teaches me is that family is God's idea, and the bonds He builds there are meant to hold. That shapes how I read the passages where it appears: not as filler, but as God's own wording for what He is doing.
RelatedEvents: The Birth of Jesus; Jesus Sends Out the Twelve; The Healing of the Man Born Blind
